book_comparison: same named book ONLY, never source-price-shopping across books; retain extra books for source diagnostics but primary outcome only one pre-ranked source per player-game/horizon
evidence_scope: NEW_ONLY source observation >= this registration and before game kickoff; source quotes captured before registration may serve as independently recorded baseline inputs but never be outcomes
exact_identity_caveat: provider player UUID is NOT verified MLBAM ID; player outcome must remain pending until independent official crosswalk and source Final
fixed_mean_reversion_control: clip(current fair probability - 0.50*(current fair probability - strictly earlier fair probability), 0.025, 0.975)
fixed_trend_model: clip(current fair OVER0.5 probability + 0.50*(current fair probability - strictly earlier same-book fair probability), 0.025, 0.975)
market: MLB player total hits OVER/UNDER exactly 0.5, exact both sides at SAME named book, provider event/player UUID, provider start +/-180s from independently verified official MLB source, source capture time same original vendor observation
original_future_source_required: exact MLB gamePk, official schedule/master original source identity with venue IDs, no unverified placeholder, no startTimeTBD, before pitch
primary_statistic: per-independent-game mean paired Brier and log-loss: trend versus current same-book market; group by exact player-game and fixed bookmaker preference, never treat correlated player observations as independent games
secondary_statistic: market movement price-direction and absolute magnitude, per-game cluster CIs and priced paper EV if exact original source odds; no winning edge from favoritism alone
source_updated_at_caveat: provider captured_at is NOT independently sportsbook quote updated-at; no execution/CLV certainty
